clips.prompt: A big cheerful bald uncle with a thin mustache in a white kimono with a wide orange belt stands in a sunny old market street. He lifts his head, sniffs the air happily, then raises his chopsticks with a big laughing smile. Gentle natural body motion, the camera stays still.

A small boy in a pointed straw hat with an orange chin ribbon and a white kimono with an orange belt stands in a sunny old market street. He looks to the left with curious wide eyes, then turns his head back and smiles. Gentle natural motion, the camera stays still.

clips.prompt: A kind grandmother with a grey bun pleats a dumpling with both hands at her wooden food cart while steam rises from the bamboo steamer behind her. She glances up and gives a small warm smile. Soft gentle motion, the camera stays still.
